name: Aetherim
look: a tiny energy golem with a crest of three curved cream plates, big blue eyes, a glowing pearl on its forehead and two big floating stone fists
entry: A little golem of pure energy that shapes a body around a pearl. Give it a tuft of hair charged with a type's energy and it soaks it up, glowing that type's colour and becoming that type.
how: Wild: rare in hills, mountains and highlands.
Give it an elemental Tuft (or the matching wool, or a feather for Flying) in its cosmetic slot and it becomes that type.
